caseName: Minnesota Public Interest Research Group v. Selective Service System
caseNameFull: Minnesota Public Interest Research Group v. Selective Service System

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. Minn. The order of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit filed August 17, 1983, transferring this case to the Supreme Court of the United States pursuant to 28 U. S. C. §1252 is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Court of Appeals to consider whether appellant has standing.

Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
